title: What is The Meadow?
body: The Meadow is a living system built around small, low-effort daily activities and gentle prompts that help strengthen meaningful attachment to family, values, identity, community, place, and yourself. Work, family, kids, chores, deadlines, responsibilities — these endless loops exhaust us. The Meadow creates space to feel like yourself again.

title: How does Nectar work?
body: Nectar is the energy unit inside The Meadow. It records your presence and marks your contribution. Nectar accumulates into Honey Units — effort-earned wealth that is yours alone, unexchangeable, and a living record of your impact. Your progress is shown on your profile, and you can share a card of it with friends.

title: What are the themes & growth stages?
body: Four core themes are available, based on your interest and curiosity. Each theme has growth stages, and there are no instructions for how to move through them. Over time, repetition happens naturally — without force, without conscious decision. You are both witness and participant. Progression comes from behaviour, not instruction: you earn what you repeat.

title: What is Norm Shift?
body: Norm Shift is the way behaviour quietly resets without us noticing. Raising your voice once becomes a pattern. Forgetting an anniversary once becomes annual. Norm Shift can move in either direction, depending on how it shapes your habits and character over time. The Meadow exists to help you notice the shift, and, if you choose, find your way back.

title: Is my progress visible to others?
body: You choose how visible you want to be. Comparison and competition are optional. With the optional collaboration feature (available for Collective tier), partners can see each other's task progress — but the choice to collaborate is always yours.

title: Why "physical evidence" of impact?
body: The jar, tokens, and cue card exist for you to interpret and assign meaning. There is real, visible evidence that you showed up, participated, and earned something — a small, honest nudge that you are still here.
